structural_change: ECTLA-2 2026-10-17 (coordinator 0co (1): k1 qkd_static_ectla_kiss REJECTED at review: TT clock insertion 350 ps, W landing face 1,100 pins at 8.5/um, SRAMs off the 43.2 lattice in x, two std-cell bands). Structural re-plan, same child RTL and cycles (ROW_RETURN_LAT = RESPONSE_LAT + 7): outline re-aspected inside the KV die's ECTL slot to 216 x 216 (5 x 5 lattice); both SRAMs stacked in ONE column on the lattice (x 86.4, y 43.2 / 129.6) with their pin edge (W) facing ONE contiguous std-cell band x 2..81 (landing capture, issuer, ECTL body); the E strip carries only the rs_o / x_i pin flops; W landing 1,100 pins over 211.6 um (5.2/um, M4 + M6); E rs_o / x_i at the grant's exact y (B abuts bottom-aligned); t0_row (S) / t1_row (N) over x 23..212 (2.7/um). slot_change_request: ECTLA-2 2026-10-17: ECTL A slot re-aspected 254.88 x 129.6 -> 216 x 216 inside the KV die's ECTL area (KV has spare area; re-grant only): the A|B|C row keeps B/C; A's bottom edge aligns with B so rs_o/x_i keep their y; t0_row/t1_row leave over x 23..212 (the head-tile pair row pins re-map), landing req/rsp on the W face over the full 216 um. Exact pins: results/arch/qwen_kv_static_ectla2_1017/qkd_static_ectla_k2.tcl.

pin_regs.reason: ECTL static calendar: QK_ISSUE_AGE, ROW_RETURN_LAT (=K_EXT 16 + RQD 2 + 3 response pin stages) and HXK count every boundary edge of the K-pass / row-return loop inside the RTL; synthesis-only pin registers (+1 per port) would shift the fixed-cycle issue/return by edges the RTL constants and the native benches do not see (age fault). Pin registration for this leaf must be done in RTL with the constants re-derived (KV die lead / Q-ATTN decision). Pin geometry, outline and io_flop_at_pins unchanged from the closed kit.
